results.title: Pace Digitek Secures ₹488 Crore NTPC GE BESS Order, Strengthens Storage Business
results.description: Pace Digitek secured a ₹488.46 crore BESS order from NTPC GE Power Services as it scales battery storage manufacturing capacity to 10 GWh by FY27.

results.title: Lava Virat Curve 5G launched with 6000mAh battery, Check Specs
results.description: Lava's new Virat Curve 5G combines a 6.67-inch curved AMOLED display, 6000mAh battery and a unique rear Mini Display with a Dimensity 7100 chipset, 50MP Sony camera and Android 16. The phone starts at ₹23,999.
